subject: Vendor notice: subprocessor addition + order form redlines
messages:
From: Ethan Shaw <legal@cloudedge.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: security@cloudedge.com
Date: Fri, 3 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: addition of subprocessor + order form redlines

Hi Chloe,

Quick heads up from CloudEdge: we are engaging a subcontractor, DataStream Ltd, to provide managed logging for the new telemetry pipeline that will process Redwood inference logs for billing and analytics. Per the MSA flowdown clause, this triggers a subprocessor notice and DPA coordination.

Attached: CloudEdge_DPA_redlines_v3.pdf and OrderForm_Amendment_A.docx — these reflect the edits our legal team needs for the Order Form (section 3.2, data routing) and an updated list of subprocessors. Can you route for approval and confirm whether Redwood requires any additional vendor evidence (SOC2, encryption-at-rest attestation) before we proceed?

Timeline: DataStream would like to be onboarded the week of 5/19; they will not process production PII until contract updates are complete.

Thanks,
Ethan Shaw
Legal Counsel, CloudEdge Systems
attachments: CloudEdge_DPA_redlines_v3.pdf, OrderForm_Amendment_A.docx

--

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 4 May 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: addition of subprocessor + order form redlines

Thanks Chloe — quick notes after an initial pass of CloudEdge_DPA_redlines_v3.pdf:

High-level legal triage (initial):
- Section 2 (Subprocessor flowdown): vendor's proposed language delegates obligations but omits explicit flowdown of our incident notification timelines. We should require that all subprocessors adhere to the same 24-hour incident notification to Redwood and same-data-retention carveouts.
- Section 4 (Audit rights): CloudEdge redline narrows audit window; we should push for audit rights on subprocessors (or documented SOC2 + third-party attestation).
- Data export / residency: CloudEdge added an exception that allows DataStream to transfer logs to EU; acceptable only with explicit customer notice and if encryption + SCCs are in place.

Requested edits for vendor:
1) Reinsert incident notification language matching MSA (24 hours).
2) Require documented SOC2 Type II report for DataStream before production access (or a compensating control checklist).
3) Preserve audit right or alternatively require a contractual attestation and a right to request periodic evidence.

Procurement / Ops asks to Jonas: confirm if SOC2 summary + encryption attestations are sufficient or if we need an on-site review. If classified high-risk, route to security for a short checklist.

I can draft a redline memo to send to CloudEdge today if you want me to do the first pass.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed_masked_redline_notes.txt

From: Ethan Shaw <legal@cloudedge.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: security@cloudedge.com, ops@datastream-ltd.com
Date: Tue, 6 May 2025 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: addition of subprocessor + order form redlines

Chloe / Kimberly / Jonas — thanks for the quick review. Quick responses:

- DataStream has provided a SOC2 Type II summary and an encryption-at-rest whitepaper; attached DataStream_SOC2_summary.pdf. They are open to our standard incident notification clause; their legal asked for a short live call to confirm exact wording.
- For audit rights, DataStream prefers to provide attestation and a quarterly compliance package rather than open-ended audits; they have offered a 30-day window to schedule an on-site review with notice.

We can commit to pausing production PII processing until we have DPA signed and evidence in hand. Tentative next steps from our side: finalize redline (CloudEdge accepts incident notification insertion), exchange attestation docs by 5/9, and then sign DPA via DocuSign.

Attachments: DataStream_SOC2_summary.pdf

Let me know preferred time for a short legal + ops call — Ethan
Ethan Shaw
Legal Counsel, CloudEdge Systems

From: chloe_martin@redwood.com
To: Ethan Shaw <legal@cloudedge.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 7 May 2025 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: addition of subprocessor + order form redlines

Ethan — thanks, and appreciated the SOC2 summary. Internal decision after legal + procurement triage: conditional approval provided we receive the signed DPA including the restored 24-hour incident notification language and either (a) a full SOC2 Type II report or (b) a compensating control package from DataStream (detailed logging/encryption attestations + quarterly compliance package). Procurement confirms the evidence will be reviewed under risk bucket B (moderate) and no on-site review required at this stage.

Next steps for CloudEdge:
1) Insert the incident notification clause into the DPA and return a tracked-change version by 5/9.
2) Ask DataStream to provide the full SOC2 Type II or the compensating control package by 5/9.
3) Once docs are received, we'll route a final sign-off and send a DocuSign envelope (I will open RDW-2247-CLD DocuSign and share link).

Marissa: please hold order form signature until the DPA is fully executed.

Ethan — we can do a 20-minute sync on 5/8 10:00am PDT if that works for legal + ops.

Thanks — Chloe
